items.name: Cisterna di Latina EZ-fill pre-sterilized syringe plant
items.claim: Stevanato Group's Cisterna di Latina plant started commercial production of EZ-fill pre-sterilized syringes in Q4 2023, built to respond to growing European biopharmaceutical demand including GLP-1s.
items.source_excerpt: The facility started commercial production in Q4 2023 and houses advanced production lines developed by Stevanato Group for the production of EZ-fill® pre-sterilized syringes with the aim of responding to the modern challenges of the European market, constantly growing in biopharmaceuticals, such as GLP-1s.

items.name: Fishers, Indiana DDS contract-manufacturing buildout
items.claim: Stevanato Group's Q1 2026 results report progress on the DDS contract manufacturing buildout at its Fishers, Indiana site, on schedule with commercial production expected to begin at the end of 2026 or early 2027.
items.source_excerpt: Progressing the DDS contract manufacturing buildout on schedule, and commercial production expected to begin at the end of 2026 or early 2027

notes: Both items are Stevanato Group's own disclosures (2024 Cisterna di Latina plant inauguration release; Q1 2026 results exhibit) naming dated GLP-1-relevant fill-finish capacity projects.
